page: Microsoft Azure D32ls_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine from the Dlsv7 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical Intel Xeon 6973P-C cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing two threads per core. Operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz, the processor includes a 480 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. The system is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded performance, with gzip compression reaching 35.73 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression achieving 14.74 GB/sec single-threaded and 204.86 GB/sec multi-threaded. In synthetic CPU tests, the instance scored 48774.22 on PassMark CPU and 31811.54 on stress-ng multi-core, both representing average tier performance. Memory bandwidth tests recorded 2356.11 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 154.42 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. For specialized workloads, the server demonstrated strong capabilities in static web serving at 54.55 GB/sec and small-model LLM inference, processing 135M model prompts at 2835.04 tokens/sec.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the D32ls_v7 offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The inclusion of advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) enhances its efficiency for vector calculations and lightweight AI inference without the expense of dedicated GPU hardware. This server is well-suited for tasks such as web serving, batch processing, single-threaded compression tasks, and moderate database operations.
description: Microsoft Azure D32ls_v7 is an x86_64 compute-optimized virtual machine powered by a 32-vCPU Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor running at 4.2 GHz. Built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, it features 16 physical cores, a 480 MB L3 cache, and 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The instance lacks local storage and GPUs but supports Premium Storage. Performance benchmarks show top-tier single-threaded gzip compression at 35.73 GB/sec and strong static web serving throughput at 54.55 GB/sec. It also delivers efficient lightweight LLM inference, processing 135M model prompts at 2835.04 tokens/sec. With advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX, the D32ls_v7 is highly suited for compute-heavy workloads, web serving, and data compression tasks that require high clock speeds but moderate memory allocations.
